stories.title: LPG tanker crashes into Kaushambi toll plaza, explodes:Driver killed, 5 employees injured; flames visible 2 km away
stories.summary: An LPG tanker crashed into a toll plaza in Uttar Pradesh's Kaushambi district at around 7 am on Friday before exploding and catching fire, leaving the tanker driver dead and five toll plaza employees injured. Police said the driver's body was recovered from inside the burnt vehicle and sent for post-mortem. The five injured employees, who sustained burn injuries, have been referred to SRN Hospital in Prayagraj for treatment. The explosion sent thick plumes of smoke and flames soaring into the sky, visible from nearly 2 kilometres away. The fire triggered panic at the toll plaza, with traffic coming to a halt as long queues of buses and cars built up on both sides of the highway. Massive blaze sparks panic The fire was so intense that no one dared to go near the tanker. Chaos broke out at the scene, with people screaming and rushing to safety as the flames engulfed the area. Fire brigade teams have reached the spot and are working to bring the blaze under control. The accident occurred at Sihori Toll Plaza in the Kokhraj police station area, around 16 kilometres from the Kaushambi district headquarters. See pictures of the accident- Here's how the incident unfolded Eyewitnesses said the LPG tanker was travelling from Kanpur to Pratapgarh when the accident occurred. According to them, the crash happened while the driver was attempting to overtake another vehicle. The tanker was reportedly travelling at around 60–70 kmph when it struck the central divider and overturned. The driver and conductor jumped out of the vehicle and fled the scene immediately after the crash. Gas leak triggered explosion and fire Superintendent of Police (SP) Satyanarayan Prajapat said preliminary information from toll plaza staff suggests that the tanker began leaking gas after the collision. The gas leak was followed by a powerful explosion, which sparked a massive fire. He added that the District Supply Officer (DSO) and a technical team have been informed and will investigate the exact cause of the incident. 16 motorcycles and 2 cars destroyed in fire at Toll Plaza yard Toll plaza employee Sanjay Nirmal said light rain had fallen around 10 minutes before the accident. "We don't know what suddenly happened. The entire tanker crashed with a loud bang, after which gas started leaking. Moments later, a massive fire broke out," he said. The flames quickly spread to the toll plaza's adjoining vehicle yard and nearby toilet block. More than 16 motorcycles and two cars parked in the yard were completely gutted. The parking area is used by toll plaza staff to keep their vehicles. Supervisor Alok Pandey, who was inside the toilet block at the time of the fire, also sustained severe burn injuries. Seven injured, 5 referred to Prayagraj SP Prajapat said seven people were injured in the accident. Five victims received initial treatment at the district hospital but were later referred to Prayagraj after their condition was found to be critical. The remaining two people sustained minor injuries and were discharged after receiving first aid. SP Satyanarayan Prajapat said- As soon as we received information about the fire near Kokhraj Toll Plaza, all fire brigade vehicles in the district and civil police personnel were immediately dispatched to the spot. Traffic was halted as a safety precaution. The fire brigade has now brought the blaze completely under control, and traffic is being restored gradually.

stories.title: From former MPs to doctors balancing politics:Who are the 13 women in UP BJP's new team?
stories.summary: Ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) announced its new state organisational team on 25 June, giving significant representation to women. In the backdrop of the political discourse surrounding women's representation, the party has appointed 13 influential women leaders to its new executive committee, including the State President of the BJP Mahila Morcha. The new team includes former Members of Parliament, grassroots political workers and professionals who have balanced successful careers with public service. The BJP has also carefully considered social engineering while selecting these women leaders. Of the 13 appointees, four belong to the General category, six to the Other Backward Classes (OBC), and three to the Scheduled Caste category. Here is a closer look at the women leaders the BJP is banking on as it seeks to counter the Samajwadi Party's PDA narrative ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections. Priyanka Rawat broke down after losing her parliamentary ticket Priyanka Rawat's parents are residents of Bareilly, while she married Raghunath Rawat of Barabanki. Having been active in student politics, she joined the BJP in 2013. At just 28 years of age, she was fielded by the BJP from the Barabanki Lok Sabha constituency in the 2014 General Election. She defeated senior Congress leader P.L. Punia by a margin of 2.11 lakh votes. Ahead of the 2019 Lok Sabha elections, however, the BJP replaced her with Upendra Rawat as its candidate. The decision left Priyanka visibly emotional, and she publicly broke down in tears. She later served as State General Secretary in the organisational team led by Swatantra Dev Singh. In the newly constituted team under State President Pankaj Chaudhary, she has now been appointed State Vice-President. Fluent in English and regarded as an effective communicator, Priyanka Rawat is considered to enjoy strong support among Dalit communities. Raised in the discipline of the Sangh Archana Mishra's father, C.P. Mishra, worked in Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh. Owing to her family's long association with the Sangh, she became associated with the Rashtriya Sevika Samiti, the women's wing of the Sangh, from a young age. Her husband, Sanjay Tripathi, is also associated with the Sangh and runs his own business. Archana has served as President of the Bakshi Ka Talab (BKT) Mandal. She has also worked extensively in Prime Minister Narendra Modi's parliamentary constituency of Varanasi, where she remained actively engaged with women during election campaigns despite the scorching summer heat. She has served as the convenor of the Ujjwala Yojana and has also held charge as the district in-charge of Barabanki. She is currently responsible for organisational work in Unnao district. SP came under attack after she praised Yogi Pooja Pal, who belongs to the Extremely Backward Pal community, entered politics following the murder of her husband, Raju Pal. She initially lost the by-election but registered her first electoral victory in 2007, defeating Ashraf, the brother of gangster-turned-politician Atiq Ahmed, while contesting on a Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) ticket. She retained her seat in the 2012 Assembly elections. She later joined the Samajwadi Party and won the Chail Assembly seat in Kaushambi on an SP ticket in the 2022 Assembly elections. During the Rajya Sabha elections held in February 2024, Pooja Pal cross-voted in favour of the BJP candidate, defying the Samajwadi Party's official stand. Later, during an Assembly session, she openly praised Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath for the government's action against the mafia. Following her rebellion, the Samajwadi Party expelled her. The BJP has now inducted her into its organisation by appointing her as a State Vice-President in the newly announced executive. Built a political career alongside her medical profession Dr Kirtika Agrawal is a renowned laparoscopic surgeon based in Prayagraj. Her husband, Dr Neeraj Agrawal, is also a General and Laparoscopic Surgeon. Her father, Girdhar Das, was associated with the Sangh for many years. Because of this family background, she became involved with the Sangh and its affiliated organisations from an early age. Alongside her medical profession, she has remained active in social work. During the Mahakumbh and the annual Magh Mela in Prayagraj, she organised free medical treatment camps and community meals. She also runs a gaushala (cow shelter) and practises organic farming. During the 2017 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, when then-BJP National President Amit Shah held his landmark roadshow in Prayagraj, Dr Agrawal served as the chief convenor for the event. From village head to Rajya Sabha MP, now State General Secretary Geeta Shakya, who belongs to the OBC community, is widely known in her region as 'Geeta alias Chandraprabha Shakya'. Her maternal home is in Hamirpur, while she is married to Mukut Singh Shakya of Auraiya. She began her professional career as a teacher and served as a headmistress between 2005 and 2010. Her husband has also worked as a teacher. The couple have two children—a son serving in the Border Security Force (BSF) and a married daughter. Geeta Shakya entered public life in 2000 after being elected Gram Pradhan (village head) of Situaapur village. She later joined the BJP. In 2021, she was appointed State President of the BJP Mahila Morcha and subsequently served as a Rajya Sabha MP. Recognising her organisational abilities, the party has now entrusted her with the important responsibility of State General Secretary in the new team led by Pankaj Chaudhary. From student politics to the State Working Committee Rajni Pandey, who has been appointed State Minister in the BJP's new Uttar Pradesh executive, began her political journey through the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) during her student years. Her husband works as a journalist. By appointing Rajni Pandey, who hails from Deoria district in eastern Uttar Pradesh, the BJP has sought to strengthen both women's representation and its Brahmin social equation. She has remained highly active in organisational work and has campaigned extensively for the party during elections in Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh. Over the years, she has also handled several important responsibilities in various organisational campaigns and programmes. From reality television to BJP State Minister Mahamedhaa Nagar, who belongs to the OBC Gurjar community, also began her political journey through the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad. She contested the Delhi University Students' Union election in 2017 and was elected Secretary by a comfortable margin. During her student politics days, she earned a reputation as an outspoken and assertive youth leader. After joining the BJP organisation, she became one of the party's prominent faces on television debates as the Uttar Pradesh BJP State Spokesperson, consistently presenting the party's views on various public platforms. Known as an accomplished public speaker, Mahamedhaa has represented India in eight countries. Before entering full-time politics, she appeared as a contestant on the popular reality television programme MTV Roadies in 2016 and featured in around ten episodes. She is unmarried and devotes her entire time to organisational work and politics. Carrying forward her father's political legacy Akanksha belongs to the Dalit Sonkar community. Her father, the late Dinesh Chandra Sonkar, was a BJP MLA. She is married to SSB Commandant Amit Sonkar, who is posted in Kanpur.nFollowing her father's death in 2012, she returned from Kanpur to Prayagraj to carry forward his political legacy. She joined the BJP between 2013 and 2014 and has remained active in the Bara Assembly constituency and the Yamunapar district organisation. She attracted the attention of the party leadership by organising several large women's conferences in the region. She has also campaigned for the BJP in Delhi, Rajasthan, Gujarat, West Bengal and Haryana. Carrying her parental home's ideology into her marital home Lodhi Kiran Nishad represents two influential OBC communities, the Lodhi and the Nishad communities. Originally from Bahoriband in Katni district of Madhya Pradesh, she married Prashant Kumar Nishad of Kanpur, who is a businessman. Senior BJP leader Uma Bharti is her elder sister by relation. Her maternal family has long been associated with the BJP. Her brother has served as a Block Pramukh, while one of her sisters has been a District Panchayat member. In contrast, members of her in-laws' family were associated with the Samajwadi Party. Her paternal uncle-in-law was Babu Manohar Lal. Inspired by Uma Bharti, Kiran joined the BJP in 2008. She later became active in public awareness campaigns through the Namami Gange Vichar Manch. The party subsequently appointed her Regional Co-convener for Kanpur-Bundelkhand. Most recently, she was serving as a State Co-convener within the organisation. Rose through the ranks without a political background Sanchita Shree Chauhan belongs to the backward Lonia (Chauhan) community of Purvanchal. Her maternal home is in Sasaram, Bihar, while she is married to businessman Sanjay Singh of Lalganj in Azamgarh. She joined the BJP in 2012. Neither her maternal nor her marital family had any political background, making her the first member of her family to enter politics. She served as the convenor for the Lalganj Lok Sabha constituency during the 2019 General Election. Recalling her early struggle, she says, "During those days, organisational meetings often continued until one o'clock in the morning. Returning home so late as a woman in a remote rural area like Lalganj was frightening, but I was never afraid." Her grassroots efforts helped the BJP secure around 82,000 votes from the Lalganj Assembly segment. Recognising her dedication, the party has now appointed her as a State Minister in the Uttar Pradesh BJP. Rose through the ranks without a political 'Godfather' Deepmala Santoshi, from the Jatav Dalit community, joined the BJP in 2010 despite having no political background in either her parental or marital family. Her husband, Devendra Kumar, is a retired Indian Army officer. Initially aspiring to become a teacher, she entered politics because of her commitment to nationalism and the BJP's ideology. She has been actively involved in grassroots campaigns across western Uttar Pradesh, strengthening the party's booth-level network. She also gained organisational experience during the West Bengal, Rajasthan and Delhi Assembly elections. On her appointment, Deepmala said the BJP gives every dedicated worker an equal opportunity to grow regardless of political connections, adding that she had no "godfather" in politics. Chose BJP despite Congress roots in her Marital family Prayagraj-born Suhasini Jaiswal was influenced by the Arya Samaj values of her father, the late Om Prakash Jaiswal, and developed an early inclination towards the RSS and the BJP. After marrying businessman Sandeep Jaiswal of Bareilly's Faridpur, she joined a family where her late father-in-law, Tulsiram Jaiswal, had been an active Congress leader and Mandal President. Despite this, she remained with the BJP. She had earlier withdrawn her claim to contest the Faridpur Municipal Council chairperson's election after the party asked her to focus on organisational work. Recognising her loyalty, the BJP has now appointed her as a State Secretary in Uttar Pradesh. From a Lohiaite family to leading the BJP Mahila Morcha Saroj Kushwaha, from the influential Kushwaha community of eastern Uttar Pradesh, joined the BJP in 1992 after beginning her student politics at Samastipur College in Bihar. While her father, Ramvyas Singh, was a Lohiaite and worked in the Railways, her marital family in Ghazipur was deeply associated with the BJP. After her mother-in-law, Dr Nirmala Kushwaha, stepped away from active politics to become a college principal, Saroj took charge of the family's political responsibilities. She was denied a BJP ticket from the Zamania Assembly constituency in 2017 but continued to work in the organisation. As the party's organisational in-charge for Mirzapur, she helped secure victories in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections and the Majhwan Assembly by-election. In recognition of her performance, the BJP has appointed her as the Uttar Pradesh Mahila Morcha President.

stories.title: 100-kg gate crushes 3-year-old girl in Lucknow:Child died after suffering severe head and chest injuries
stories.summary: A three-year-old girl was crushed to death after the iron gate of her house collapsed on her in Lucknow. Hearing her screams, family members rushed to the spot and took her to the hospital, where doctors declared her dead. The family later cremated the child without a post-mortem examination. The incident took place on Thursday, 19 June, in Mohiddinpur village under the PGI police station area. The iron gate at the house of Suraj Kumar suddenly came off its hinges and fell at around 8.30 am. His three-year-old daughter, Anvi, who was playing near the gate, was trapped underneath it and died. Mother had gone to drop elder daughter at tuition Suraj Kumar lives in Mohiddinpur with his wife Seema and their two daughters, four-year-old Srishti and three-year-old Anvi. According to the family, Seema had gone to drop Srishti at a nearby tuition class at around 8.30 am, while Suraj was having breakfast at home. He was feeding Anvi when she wandered towards the main gate while playing. Suddenly, the heavy iron gate came loose and collapsed on top of her. Hearing her cries, Suraj and other family members rushed outside, removed the gate and took her to the hospital. However, doctors declared her dead on arrival. Gate had been installed eight years ago Anvi's uncle, Ashish, said the family had built the house around eight years ago and installed a heavy iron gate weighing more than 100 kg. He believes years of regular use had weakened the hinges and the cement holding them in place, causing the gate to collapse. Police reached the spot after receiving information and completed the inquest proceedings. The family refused to allow a post-mortem examination, so the exact cause of death could not be officially confirmed. However, the child suffered severe head and chest injuries after being trapped under the gate, which is believed to have caused her death. She was later cremated in the village.

stories.summary: In a tragic road accident in Madhya Pradesh’s Dewas district, a young man lost his life while his girlfriend and the car driver sustained injuries. The girlfriend was reportedly kept unaware of her boyfriend’s death for several hours after the crash and continued to plead with hospital staff to let her meet him. According to information, the accident took place around 5 am on Friday in Tonk Khurd. An unidentified vehicle allegedly collided with the car. The deceased has been identified as Mohit Vajpayee, a resident of Uttar Pradesh. A young woman travelling with him and the driver were also injured in the crash. All three were rushed to the district hospital following the accident. Doctors at the hospital declared Mohit Vajpayee dead after examination. Meanwhile, the car driver reportedly left the hospital during treatment without informing anyone. The injured woman, however, kept asking about Mohit. Witnesses said she repeatedly broke down in tears and pleaded with doctors and staff, saying, “Please let me meet my Mohit just once.” See 3 pictures related to the accident... Social media friendship turned into relationship The injured woman told police that she had met Mohit through Instagram about a year ago. As their conversations grew, they developed a close relationship and eventually decided to get married. According to her, neither family was aware of their relationship. The couple was travelling from Uttar Pradesh to Indore on Friday with plans to get married in a temple. However, the accident near Tonk Khurd changed their lives forever. Father says Mohit was already married After receiving information about the accident, Mohit’s father Prem Narayan reached the district hospital. He said the family lives in Indore and that Mohit had travelled to Uttar Pradesh two days earlier with his mother to attend a family wedding. According to his father, Mohit had spoken to him on Thursday and said he was returning to Indore after dropping his mother back. He further revealed that Mohit was already married and had a child. Family members said they had no knowledge of the injured woman or her relationship with Mohit. According to them, he had never discussed the matter at home. Missing report of young woman registered in Uttar Pradesh Constable Neeraj Chaudhary of Haidergarh police station in Uttar Pradesh said the young woman’s family had filed a missing person complaint on Thursday evening. A missing person report has been registered and her family has been informed about the accident. Police said they are independently verifying all facts related to the case.

stories.title: UP man is beheaded with a sword over a slap:Wife clings to body, demands 'a life for a life'; victim had beaten accused over molestation
stories.summary: A young man was brutally beheaded with a sword at a market square in Sant Kabir Nagar, Uttar Pradesh, allegedly to avenge a slap he had given the accused five days earlier. The victim had confronted and slapped the accused after he allegedly molested his niece during a wedding ceremony. According to the police, the murder was the result of that personal rivalry. The incident took place late on Thursday night in the Bakhira police station area, around 28 km from the district headquarters. The victim was returning home when the accused, along with four accomplices, allegedly surrounded him and attacked him with a sword. The blow to his throat was so severe that he died on the spot. Enraged by the incident, villagers set fire to the accused's shop and house. As the situation deteriorated, police forces from three police stations had to be deployed. When the police started taking the body for a post-mortem, angry family members tried to stop the ambulance and scuffled with the police. Late at night, the ADG Zone also reached the spot and inspected the crime scene. Meanwhile, on Friday, a large number of women came out on the streets carrying sticks. The women protested by banging sticks and demanded the encounter of the accused. Seeing the situation deteriorate, the police lathi-charged and dispersed them from there. The deceased's wife, demanding the encounter with the accused, said, "My husband was brutally murdered. We want life for a life, nothing less than that." Currently, based on the complaint of the deceased's father, the police have registered a case against 4 accused, including three named individuals. See pictures related to the incident Know the full story Anand (30), a resident of Kolki Chamarsan village in Bakhira police station area, used to work as a tile layer. Eyewitness and the deceased's cousin, Rohit, stated that Anand had come to Babhani Chowk around 7 PM to deliver a machine. After delivering the machine, he bought some items and stayed at the chowk for a long time. Then, late at night, he was returning home. During this time, Nasir Ali (18), a resident of a nearby village, arrived there with his 4-5 companions. One companion handed him a sword. Then he attacked Anand's neck with the sword. After the incident, all the accused closed their shops and fled. According to Rohit, the main accused is Nasir Ali, while the person who handed over the sword is a resident of Jeevdhara village. After the murder, two other people were seen with him, cleaning the weapon and helping to destroy evidence. Enraged mob set fire to the accused's shop and house Meanwhile, enraged villagers started protesting by blocking the road at Babhani intersection. During this, the shop and house of the accused Nasir were set on fire. Police from three police stations reached the spot after receiving information. SP Sandeep Kumar Meena and CO also arrived with force. They pacified and calmed down the angry villagers. Late at night at 11 PM, ADG Ashok Mutha Jain, DIG Sanjeev Tyagi, and DM Alok Kumar also reached the spot. Police have deployed several teams in search of the main accused Nasir Ali and his associates. It is being told that there is a distance of about two kilometres between Nasir's and Anand's houses. Now know what is the reason for the murder? According to family members, five days ago, Nasir Ali was molesting Anand's niece at a wedding ceremony. Upon learning this, Anand protested and slapped him. Since then, Nasir had been holding a grudge. The police's initial investigation also considers this dispute as the reason for the murder. Ambulance carrying the dead body broke down Amidst the uproar after the murder, Anand's body was being taken by ambulance for a post-mortem. On the way, the ambulance suddenly broke down. Despite much effort, the vehicle did not start, so the policemen had to push it. During this, angry women also tried to stop the ambulance. After about half an hour, the ambulance was able to restart, after which the body was sent for post-mortem. Two innocent daughters lost their father's protection Anand was married about seven years ago. Besides his wife, he has two daughters in the family. The elder daughter, Ananya, is three years old, while the younger daughter, Aradhya, is six months old. Anand was the youngest of three brothers. According to family members, he had come home from Chennai on May 6 and was preparing to return a few days later. FIR against 4, including 3 named individuals Police have registered a case against 4 people, including 3 named individuals, based on a complaint filed by Anand's father, Indresh. The accused include Nasir and Nirhu, residents of Kusumha village in Bakheera police station area, Jaigam, a resident of Jivdhara village, and one other unknown person. ADG said - Arrests will be made soon ADG Ashok Mutha Jain said that the young man had stopped in the market to buy goods. During that time, he was murdered by slitting his throat. In the initial investigation, a case of dispute at a wedding ceremony has come to light. Several police teams are continuously raiding to arrest the accused. 500 people arrived with sticks and blocked the road On Friday morning, around 10 am, once again, about 500 villagers, including family members, arrived and blocked the Lilabad-Mehdawal road. The villagers, armed with sticks, arrived in tractor-trolleys. The police tried to pacify the villagers, but they did not agree. Women started banging sticks in front of the police. They started pushing and shoving. The police used force to snatch the sticks from the women. Bulldozer action on the accused's shop Seeing the anger of the villagers, the police swiftly took bulldozer action on the main accused Nasir's barber shop and his associates' chicken shop on Friday afternoon. The police demolished all three temporary shops.

stories.title: 'Kangana ji, beware!':FIR lodged against SP MLA for social media post
stories.summary: A case has been registered in Pratapgarh, UP, against the SP MLA who recently made a controversial comment on actress-turned-MP Kangana Ranaut. MLA Rakesh Kumar Verma's Facebook post was published on June 17. It read, “Kangana madam, be careful, stay fully alert…lest Saayoni Ghosh usurps your place.” In this post, there is a photo of the SP MLA at the bottom, while on the top side, there are photos of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Ranaut, and MP Saayoni Ghosh. So far, Kangana Ranaut has not issued any statement on this matter. This FIR against the SP MLA has been registered by the district president of BJP Yuva Morcha Anshuman Singh. Police gathering digital evidence The case has been filed at the Pratapgarh Cyber Police Station. Inspector Rajiv Kumar Tiwari, who is investigating the case, said the social media post will be investigated and its authenticity, electronic records, and other digital evidence are being collected. Criticising the SP MLA, Anshuman Singh said that using such language against a female Parliamentarian on a public platform sends the wrong message to society. Verma is a repeat offender, says BJP leader Anshuman Singh said the Raniganj MLA is a repeat offender. “They (SP leaders) don't know how to talk to women and how to respect them. Samajwadi Party always has had such a dual character. A few days ago, they also commented on Ramcharitmanas. But at that time, a case could not be registered against them,” he said. FIR showcases unbridled power, says SP MLA SP MLA Rajesh Kumar Verma said that this case has been registered due to the arrogance of power. “Whose insult has happened in this? I gave the example of a leader from our alliance, who is an MP (Saayoni). BJP pressured her and made her join their party,” he said. “I had advised her (Kangana) to be careful, lest her place also be taken. What is objectionable in this? This is a case filed purely out of the arrogance of power. Nothing else,” Verma stated. Who is Saayoni Ghosh? Saayoni Ghosh is a Bengali actress and politician. She is active in West Bengal politics and was associated with the TMC for a long time. She was elected as an MP in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections. She has worked in many Bengali films and TV serials. After this, she entered politics and took on important responsibilities in the youth wing of TMC. In recent days, there is talk about differences within TMC and Saayoni's political stance. It is being said that she is going to join the BJP. A few days ago, 17 rebel MPs of TMC met the Lok Sabha Speaker and Saayoni was among them.

stories.title: Lucknow University protest enters 18th day:Students roar at protest meeting; say they now fight till the end
stories.summary: The student protest at Lucknow University continued for the 18th consecutive day. On Friday, students organised a 'Chhatra Panchayat' (student assembly) against the university administration. From morning, 40 to 50 students started gathering at Gate No. 1, and the sit-in protest continued until around 4 PM. During this, students chanted slogans vigorously and accused the administration of ignoring their demands. The protesting students said that their voices are not being heard, and therefore, now it will be a fight to the finish. Activists from various student organisations, including AISA and SFI, also participated in the 'Chhatra Panchayat' and protested in support of the expelled students. See 2 pictures Political parties support students Many former office bearers of the student union have also come to the protest site and protested with the students. Meanwhile, several MLAs and MPs from SP and Congress have also joined the students' protest. However, the university administration does not currently appear to be considering the reinstatement of the students. Meanwhile, students are adamant on their demand to withdraw the increased fee hike, in addition to the reinstatement of the expelled students. 'No compromise will be made with the interests of the students' Prince Prakash stated that the university administration remains firm on its stubborn stance. Today, students are holding a 'Chhatra Panchayat' (student assembly), and after this, they will run a signature campaign. And if needed, they will also gherao (surround) the Chief Minister's residence and the Legislative Assembly. But no compromise will be made with the interests of the students. The protest started on June 2 after the expulsion of 3 students. Students who have been continuously protesting since June 2 are receiving continuous support from the SP and Congress. Former office bearers of the student union are also openly supporting the expelled students.

stories.title: Tower panel catches fire in Varanasi's Bhelupur:Petrol pump is located beside it; fire brigade reaches spot after 30 minutes
stories.summary: Panic spread in the area on Friday after a sudden fire broke out in a mobile tower located in front of the ACP office in Varanasi's Bhelupur area. The fire incident occurred while repair work was underway on the tower. However, the relief was that the employees working on the tower had already climbed down when the fire broke out, preventing any casualties. According to eyewitnesses, smoke and flames suddenly started rising from the tower. As soon as the fire broke out, panic spread among the nearby residents because a petrol pump is located right next to the tower. Considering the potential danger, the petrol pump was immediately shut down. Local residents say that if the fire had reached the petrol pump, a major accident could have occurred. Fire brigade arrived 40 minutes after the information During the incident, sparks emanating from the tower were reaching nearby areas. It was reported that a spark that flew off burned a person's T-shirt. However, there is no information of anyone being seriously injured in this incident. Local residents alleged that the fire brigade team reached the spot approximately 30 minutes after the fire broke out. After the incident, local residents protested against the tower and demanded the administration to remove it from the residential and busy area. Fear persisted as long as the fire raged Petrol pump operator Ram Yadav said that as soon as information about the fire was received, we immediately called the fire brigade and the CM helpline number. Considering the potential danger, the petrol pump was immediately shut down. There was a lot of fear. We also informed the Area Officer's office located opposite. With their help, the fire brigade vehicle reached the spot, and the fire was brought under control. Until the fire was extinguished, an atmosphere of fear prevailed throughout the area.

stories.title: UP faces deeper power crisis:Singrauli's both HV lines fail, 3,000 MW supply is disrupted; 7 units stay shut
stories.summary: Due to intense heat, electricity demand in the state has reached a record level. At the same time, on Wednesday evening, both high-voltage transmission lines in the Singrauli region tripped due to an earth fault. As a result, all three units of NTPC's Rihand Thermal Power Station shut down, affecting a total of 3000 MW of production. Uttar Pradesh incurred a loss of approximately 950 MW of electricity due to this. Additionally, Ghatampur Unit-2 (660 MW) and Khurja Unit-2 (660 MW) from the central sector, Lalitpur Thermal Project Unit-3 (660 MW), Anpara-C Unit-1 (600 MW), and Rosa Unit-1 (300 MW) from the private sector were also affected due to various technical reasons. Obra-C Unit-2 and Harduaganj-D Unit-9 of the State Power Generation Corporation also shut down due to technical faults, which were later successfully restarted. Power crisis will deepen Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Limited (UPPCL) has taken swift steps to handle the situation. Efforts are being made to arrange additional power from other available sources. The company is continuously monitoring the power system, and all necessary measures are being taken to ensure a better power supply.

stories.title: 'He attempted rape':Kanpur woman alleges 'Bottle Baba' molested her during ritual; police file FIR, arrest accused
stories.summary: In Kanpur Dehat, a woman has accused Hariom Yadav, operator of Haridham Sarkar Ashram known as 'Bottle Baba', of molestation and attempted rape. The victim said- The Baba called me to the ashram saying there was a shadow of dark forces and started obscene acts under the guise of worship. He attempted rape. When she raised an alarm and family members arrived, she was somehow able to get out of the ashram. Based on the woman's complaint, police have registered an FIR against the Baba along with 5 named persons and some unknown people. The accused Baba was arrested and presented in court today, Friday, and sent to jail. Haridham Sarkar Ashram is located in Chain Ka Purwa village in Devrahat police station area. See pictures Read the full story Hariom Yadav, known as 'Bottle Baba', is located at Haridham Sarkar Ashram, about 40 km away from Kanpur Dehat district headquarters. He claims to cure diseases like cancer by blowing into bottled water. Large numbers of people attend his gatherings. According to a woman resident of a village in the Fafund police station area of Auraiya, her father-in-law and two brothers-in-law had called the baba home on June 6 to perform worship rituals. During the worship, the baba claimed that she was under the shadow of dark forces, which would require special worship and rituals to remove. The woman alleges that on this pretext, 40 thousand rupees were also taken from her. While leaving, the baba called her to Haridham Sarkar Ashram on June 15 and spoke about conducting special rituals. Took her to a room under the pretext of worship According to the woman, on June 15, her two brothers-in-law took her to the ashram on a bike. There, the baba called her into a room, saying he would perform a special ritual. It is alleged that in the room, the baba started behaving obscenely with her and attempted to rape her. When she resisted, the baba, both brothers-in-law and other people beat her up. The woman also alleges that they tried to kill her by strangling her. She somehow managed to escape from there. Case filed against Baba and 5 named, 5 unknown persons The woman reached the Bhognipur police station about 15 km away from there and narrated the entire incident to the police. After this, she was sent to Devrahat police station. After medical examination, on June 18, a case was registered at Devrahat police station against Hariom Yadav, the woman's two brothers-in-law, Ramveer and Sukhveer, Baba's disciples Deepak and Kundan, and several others under sections of molestation, assault and other charges. Taking action, the police have arrested Baba and one of his disciples. Baba said - A leader is conspiring to frame me Baba said regarding the allegations against him that false accusations have always been made against Sanatanis. Now false allegations are being made against me too. God is watching everything. This is all a conspiracy. A leader from Dibiyapur, Ashish Dwivedi, is conspiring to trap me in this. He called me saying, "Baba, we will deal with you." My ashram is not small. It is built on 8 bighas. We will protect Sanatanis. There will be a saints' congregation. Saints will remain; no one can destroy this even if they want to. CO Rajeev Sirohi informed- An investigation was conducted based on the woman's complaint. After this, an FIR was registered and the accused Baba Hariom and his disciple Deepak were arrested and sent to jail. Raids are being conducted to search for the remaining accused.Baba's ashram is built on about 8 bighas of land.Ashram built on 8 bighas, entry to darbar only with waterBaba Hariom has an ashram built on about 8 bighas in Chain Ka Purwa village. He lives in this ashram and holds his darbar here. It is said that earlier a receipt of 100 rupees was issued from the ashram for worship, which is now 250 rupees. Around 100 to 200 people visit the darbar daily.Entry to the darbar is only with a water bottle costing 20 rupees. Baba blows on this water. He claims that water blown upon by him can cure even diseases like cancer. Apart from this, he also claims to drive away ghosts by whipping.

stories.title: Crore-scale fraud alleged with Park Hospital doctors in Gorakhpur:Drug company accused of hiding profits; FIR lodged at Cantt police station
stories.summary: A multi-crore embezzlement case involving two doctors of Park Hospital in Gorakhpur has come to light. The doctors have accused the operators of Medrev Healthcare Private Limited of manipulating hospital records, hiding profits, and trying to usurp their share of the earnings from the hospital pharmacy. According to the police complaint, the hospital had a written agreement with the company to run the OPD and IPD pharmacy. Under the deal, 75 per cent of the profit was to be paid to the doctors. However, the accused allegedly showed a huge gap between sales and profits to reduce the doctors' share. Acting on a court order, the Cantt police have registered an FIR and started an investigation into the matter. Know the full story Dr. Onkar Nath Rai, co-owner of Park Hospital, informed the police that he and Dr Dharmendra Kumar Rai had a written agreement with Medrev Healthcare Private Limited. Under the agreement, the company's OPD and IPD pharmacies operated inside the hospital. It was decided that 75 per cent of the pharmacy's profit would go to the doctors and 25 per cent to the company. It is alleged that a huge discrepancy was found in the sales and profit-related figures from March 2019 to October 2024 during the checking of company records and software data. A discrepancy of Rs 1.65 crore was found He states that a total profit discrepancy of more than Rs 1.65 crore has emerged between the software report and the report provided by the company to the hospital. It is alleged that 75 per cent of the doctors' share in this amount, approximately Rs 1.24 crore, was deliberately embezzled by falsifying data. He states that there have been business relations between both parties since 2015, and it is possible that similar irregularities might have been committed earlier as well. The doctor stated that he complained about the matter to Cantt Police Station and the SSP, but no case has been registered so far. On the orders of the court, the police of Cantt Police Station have registered an FIR and started investigating the matter.

stories.title: UP 'Launda' dancer shot dead in Bihar:Refused demand to dance again; had resisted going to isolated place before being shot
stories.summary: A 'launda dancer' from Deoria, UP, was shot dead in Bihar. After the performance ended, he was resting behind the stage. Then three youths arrived there and insisted that he dance again. When the dancer refused, they tried to forcibly take him to a secluded place. When he resisted, the accused shot him and fled. The bullet hit him in the stomach. Hearing the gunshot, his companions rushed to the spot. They started taking him to the hospital, but he died on the way. This incident, which occurred on Thursday night, is from the Kateya police station area of Gopalganj district. The deceased has been identified as Sonu Gond (32). See pictures Sonu died before reaching the hospital. Police have sent the body for a post-mortem. Now read the complete story in sequence Sonu Gaud was a resident of Mahua Patan village in Tarkulwa police station area of Deoria. He worked as a 'launda dancer' (male dancer performing female roles) in a dance-drama party. On Thursday, Dharmendra Kushwaha, son of Manager Kushwaha, a resident of Patohwa village, was getting married. The wedding procession had gone to Mahendra Kushwaha's house in Patohwa village, Gopalganj district. The dance-drama party also reached Bihar with the procession. Six dancers, including Sonu, were part of the program. Ramayan Yadav, the organizer of the dance party, said- The program was running smoothly. After the performance ended, all the artists were resting in a tent behind the stage. Sonu was also sitting there. Then some youths came there and forcibly started pulling his hand. They wanted to take him with them. When Sonu resisted and tried to free himself, a youth pointed a pistol at his stomach and shot him. Had been working in dance parties for 7 years Sonu had been working as a dancer in various dance parties for the past seven years. After the death of his parents, he was the sole earning member of the family. His family included his wife, three young children, and a younger brother, all of whom were his responsibility. Accused identified - SHO Katiya SHO Awadhesh Kumar said- The matter is being investigated. The accused have been identified and raids are underway for their arrest. Now know what Lounda Dance is This is a traditional folk dance style of Bihar, Eastern Uttar Pradesh, and especially the Bhojpuri region. In this, male artists dress up as women and perform dance and acting. This dance has long been popular in rural areas at weddings, processions, fairs, and cultural events. How did Launda Dance start? Bhikari Thakur, the great artist of Bhojpuri folk theatre, played a significant role in popularising Launda Naach. stories.title: Yogi on Ram Temple offering theft:Says every accused will face action; asks devotees in Ayodhya to wait 15 more days
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath visits Ayodhya on Friday amid the Ram Temple donation theft controversy. He first offers prayers at the Hanumangarhi Temple before visiting the Ram Temple to seek the blessings of Ram Lalla. Addressing the issue, Yogi says people in the Opposition once opened fire on those who raised slogans in the name of Lord Ram. "Just look at their double standards. The Congress did everything it could to stop the Ram Temple from being built. It even shamelessly argued in the Supreme Court that Lord Ram never existed. The same Congress is now showing great concern over Ayodhya," he says. The Chief Minister adds that anyone with evidence should hand it over to the Special Investigation Team (SIT). He appeals to devotees to remain patient, saying, "Lord Ram taught us the values of dignity and restraint. Devotees struggled for 500 years for the Ram Temple. Wait for another 15 days. Do not worry. Do not fall for those trying to defame Ayodhya. If anyone is guilty, no matter who they are, they will not be spared." The controversy began after Samajwadi Party leader and former minister Pawan Pandey claimed on 7 June that between ₹5 crore and ₹7.5 crore had been stolen from the Ram Temple donations. SP chief Akhilesh Yadav also questioned the government's silence and said the court should examine the matter. Temple Trust General Secretary Champat Rai denied that any such theft had been established. As the controversy grew, BJP leader Dr Rajneesh Singh wrote to the Prime Minister on 9 June seeking a CBI probe. The following day, the Prime Minister's Office (PMO) sought a report from the Temple Trust. So far, five people, Lavkush, Avneesh, Anukalp, Karune and Ramshankar alias Tinnu, have been named in the donation theft case. Around ₹2 crore has been recovered based on their disclosures. All of them were involved in counting the temple donations. Gold was also recovered from the house of Temple Trust employee Ramshankar Yadav alias Tinnu on 13 June, although the exact quantity has not yet been confirmed. What the SIT has done in four days of investigation • Day 1: The SIT questioned Temple Trust General Secretary Champat Rai and invited member Gopal Rao. Around eight to ten employees under suspicion are questioned for nearly six hours. • Day 2: Investigators again question Champat Rai and Gopal Rao for about four hours each. • Day 3: The team questions bank officials and representatives of the private agency responsible for counting the cash donations. Bank statements and financial records are also examined. • Day 4: The SIT spends nearly 10 hours inside the temple complex. Trustee Dr Anil Mishra is questioned for around four hours about the counting, handling and bank deposit process for donations, as well as the appointment of Anukalp Mishra and Lavkush Mishra. The team also questions Tinnu Yadav for about 90 minutes and cross-checks his statements with Dr Mishra's version.

stories.title: 'I'll pick you up from your house':Haryanvi dancer gets abduction threat; caller identifies himself as Chambal's don, says he has fallen in love
stories.summary: The Haryanvi stage performer, who came into the limelight due to the waist-touching controversy, has now received death threats. The dancer herself shared a call audio related to the incident. In it, the caller is threatening to forcibly abduct her from her home. The dancer says - on Thursday evening, she received a call from an unknown number on her mobile. The caller first started expressing love, and then talked about keeping an AK-47 at home. In the audio, the accused says I am a cannon, the don of Chambal. I will take out an AK-47 from your house. Before this, on June 3 in Hathras, UP, a young man had touched her waist during a stage performance. The dancer had slapped the young man right on the stage. Now read... What the caller said to the dancer The stage dancer has shared 2 audio-videos related to this call on her social media account. In these videos, which are 2 minutes and 1 minute long, the caller claims to already know the dancer. However, Dainik Bhaskar does not confirm these audio-videos. Read what transpired between the two First Audio-Video Recording Caller: Madam, I saw your reel. Dancer: The whole world watches reels, that doesn't mean you should call me. Caller: I've fallen in love with you. Dancer: I will use very foul language. You are being rude. Why do you use such words that force me to swear or speak inappropriately? Have you fallen in love in your old age? Where did you get my number? Caller: I will pull an AK-47 out of your house. Dancer: Say again what you were saying? Caller - If you want to record, go ahead, no problem, okay. Dancer: What do you mean an AK-47 will be taken out of the house? Second audio-video recording Dancer: Why are you bothering me? Caller: I will forcibly pick you up from your house. Dancer: How can you forcibly pick me up from my house? Caller: I am a cannon and a dacoit from Chambal? Dancer: If you are from Chambal, how can you forcibly pick me up? Caller: After picking you up, I will tell you how I can... (swearing) If you record this, I will *** you. Dancer: I didn't say anything to you. Nor am I recording you. There's no recording on an iPhone anyway. Caller: I have an iPhone too, are you thinking only you have an iPhone? Dancer: I have never seen you, nor have I ever met you, so how did you fall in love with me? Caller: Do you want to record this and play it for the police? Tell them this is the don of Chambal. Dancer: I swear on my brother that I haven't recorded anything? Read these controversies related to stage dancers Controversy-1: On June 3, during a stage performance in Hathras, Uttar Pradesh, a young man touched her waist. Following this, the dancer slapped the young man on stage. In this case, the dancer has accused UP police of applying weak sections in the case. Controversy-2: On the night of June 16, in Noida's Alpha Market, two youths also tried to take a selfie with a stage dancer. The dancer stated that she was with her family at that time. Despite being refused, the youths turned on their mobile cameras. Following this, an altercation and pushing ensued between both parties.

stories.title: SP to revive 2011 election formula in UP:Plans state-level Gorakhpur convention; Akhilesh Yadav to also attend
stories.summary: The Samajwadi Party (SP) has begun preparations for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections and is looking to recreate a strategy that proved successful 15 years ago. In November 2011, when the party was out of power, SP organised a three-day state executive meeting at Champa Devi Park in Gorakhpur. A few months later, the party returned to power with a full majority in the 2012 Assembly elections. This time, SP is preparing to hold a major conference in Gorakhpur after the monsoon. While the exact format of the event has not yet been finalised, party leaders have confirmed that SP national president Akhilesh Yadav and senior leaders from across the state will participate. Gorakhpur leaders given responsibility for conference On 17 June, Akhilesh Yadav convened a meeting in Lucknow with SP office-bearers, senior leaders, elected representatives and former representatives from Gorakhpur. During the meeting, detailed discussions were held on organisational and political issues relating to the district. Leaders were informed that a large-scale conference would be organised in Gorakhpur and responsibility for its arrangements would rest with local party leaders. They were instructed to work collectively to ensure the event's success and to finalise the venue and schedule. The conference may be held over one day or extend beyond that, depending on the final plan. State President to visit Gorakhpur soon SP state president Shyam Lal Pal is expected to visit Gorakhpur shortly to review preparations for the proposed conference. He will hold discussions with local leaders and members of the district executive committee regarding the event's venue, date and organisational arrangements. The decisions taken during these meetings will subsequently be communicated to Akhilesh Yadav. District president Brijesh Kumar Gautam said the conference is being organised on the instructions of the national president and that every effort will be made to ensure its success. SP aims to demonstrate strength in CM Yogi's stronghold The party is planning to use the conference to demonstrate its political strength in Gorakhpur, the home turf of Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. Fifteen years ago, SP showcased its organisational strength through a major conference before the elections. Party leaders believe Gorakhpur has since become even more politically significant, as several prominent figures in both the BJP government and party organisation are associated with the city. SP leaders argue that a successful gathering in Gorakhpur would send a strong political message across the state and energise party workers ahead of the election campaign. Workers from several districts are also expected to participate. Akhilesh to target state government from Gorakhpur The conference is also expected to serve as a platform for Akhilesh Yadav to attack the BJP-led state government directly from the Chief Minister's constituency. During recent engagements in Lucknow, the SP chief presented what he described as a report card on Gorakhpur. Party leaders say a similar assessment may be presented during the conference. Alongside highlighting local issues, the event is expected to focus on motivating party workers and strengthening organisational unity ahead of the 2027 elections. Gorakhpur's political landscape Gorakhpur district comprises two Lok Sabha constituencies and nine Assembly constituencies. At present, the BJP holds both Lok Sabha seats as well as all nine Assembly seats in the district. One Assembly constituency linked to the neighbouring Sant Kabir Nagar Lok Sabha seat also falls within Gorakhpur district. While Sant Kabir Nagar is represented by an SP MP, the Khajani Assembly constituency within that parliamentary segment is represented by a BJP MLA. In the 2017 Assembly elections, SP managed to win only one of the district's nine Assembly seats. With the 2027 elections approaching, the party is now intensifying efforts to make inroads into BJP-held constituencies and strengthen its position in eastern Uttar Pradesh.

stories.title: CM Yogi on Ram Mandir offering theft row:'No guilty person will be spared'; asks devotees to wait 15 days, saying SIT will establish the facts
stories.summary: Amid the controversy over the alleged theft of offerings at the Ram Mandir, Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath visited Ayodhya on Friday and criticised Opposition parties over their remarks on the issue. Addressing a public gathering, Yogi said those who had once ordered firing on people raising slogans in the name of Lord Ram were now speaking about the Mandir and Ram devotees. He accused the Congress of trying to prevent the construction of the Ram Mandir and said the party had argued before the Supreme Court that Lord Ram did not exist. “The same Congress is now expressing concern over Ayodhya and claiming that Ram devotees have been insulted,” Yogi said. Targets SP over comments on Ram devotees Taking aim at the Samajwadi Party, Yogi said the party was alleging that Ram devotees had been insulted. “Those who ordered firing on kar sevaks and Ram devotees are now giving lectures,” he said. The Chief Minister said the state government had constituted a Special Investigation Team (SIT) at the request of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust to investigate the allegations. “The SIT will establish the facts. I appeal to everyone not to make comments that may hurt the sentiments of Ram devotees,” he said. Submit evidence to SIT, says Chief Minister Yogi said anyone with evidence related to the case should submit it to the SIT. Appealing for patience, he said, “Lord Ram taught the values of dignity and discipline. Ram devotees struggled for 500 years for the construction of the Mandir. Wait for another 15 days and let the investigation proceed.” He urged people not to be influenced by those trying to defame Ayodhya and asked them not to make statements that could affect the probe. No guilty person will be spared Yogi said no one found guilty would escape action. “If any person is involved in wrongdoing, regardless of who they are, they will not be spared,” he said. The Chief Minister also appealed to people to refrain from making public statements until the SIT completes its inquiry, saying such comments could influence the investigation.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi celebrates his 56th birthday at Congress headquarter:Party workers depict him as 'Lord Parshuram' in Varanasi, pour milk over photograph
stories.summary: Birthday wishes poured in from across the political spectrum, for the Lok Sabha Leader of the Opposition and Congress MP Rahul Gandhi as he turned 56 on Friday. Gandhi arrived at the Congress headquarters to celebrate his birthday with party workers, accompanied by his sister and Party national general secretary Priyanka Gandhi Vadra. PM Narendra Modi, Congress party president Mallikarjun Kharge and several leaders of the INDIA bloc and BJP extended their wishes for Gandhi. Posters celebrating Rahul Gandhi's birthday were displayed outside the Congress headquarters, Indira Bhawan, in Delhi. In Varanasi, Congress workers performed special rituals and offered prayers in his honour. Congress workers perform rituals in the middle of the Ganga On Friday, Congress workers travelled by boat to the middle of the River Ganga in Varanasi. They carried a waterproof cut-out depicting Rahul Gandhi in the form of Lord Parshuram. In the cut-out, Rahul Gandhi was shown holding an axe in one hand and a copy of the Constitution of India in the other. Workers performed a Rudrabhishek accompanied by Vedic chants. They also cut an 11-kg laddu cake and prayed for Rahul Gandhi's long, healthy and successful life. See photos- Youth Congress leader explains symbolism behind the celebration Youth Congress district president Vikas Singh said Rahul Gandhi consistently stands against what he described as anti-democratic forces, corruption and those who disregard the Constitution. He said Rahul Gandhi continues to fight for democratic values, social justice and constitutional principles, while raising the voice of ordinary citizens. According to Singh, Rahul Gandhi symbolises struggle and resistance. Drawing a parallel with Lord Parshuram, he said that just as Parshuram destroyed evil and oppression, Rahul Gandhi would challenge those who oppose democratic values and constitutional principles. ‘Politics should serve the last person in society’ Vikas Singh further said Rahul Gandhi's politics is not limited to gaining power but is rooted in ensuring justice and rights reach the last person in society. He said the birthday celebrations were organised in the spirit of service, commitment and prayer. Expressing his personal aspiration, Singh said Congress workers hoped Rahul Gandhi would become Prime Minister after the next general election. He added that this sentiment was the reason behind portraying him in the form of Lord Parshuram, noting that India is a democratic country where everyone has the freedom to express their views. PM Modi and other leaders extend birthday wishes Prime Minister Narendra Modi posted on X: Birthday greetings to Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi Ji. I wish him good health and a long life. M. K. Stalin said Rahul Gandhi has consistently spoken for national progress, democratic values and the welfare of all sections of society. He wished him good health and a long life. Telangana CM Revanth Reddy said Rahul Gandhi's commitment to democratic values, social justice and public welfare continues to inspire many people. Congress General Secretary K. C. Venugopal said that at a time when the country faces challenges relating to democracy and the Constitution, Rahul Gandhi has emerged as a strong voice for an inclusive and democratic India. He described him as a source of hope for young people, the poor and marginalised communities. Sanjay Raut wished Rahul Gandhi good health, happiness and continued strength in public service, expressing hope that the coming year would bring him success and fulfilment. | Rahul Gandhi celebrates 56th birthday: From ₹11 crore properties ₹3.81 crore in mutual funds, lets decode how RaGa invests Rahul Gandhi worked under a different name for three years Rahul Gandhi was born on 19 June 1970 in New Delhi. He is the son of former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi and former Congress president Sonia Gandhi. He is the elder of two siblings, with Priyanka Gandhi being younger. He began his schooling at Modern School before moving to The Doon School. Following the assassination of Indira Gandhi in 1984, security concerns forced him to continue his education from home. In 1989, he enrolled at St. Stephen's College, but again had to discontinue his studies because of security concerns. He later moved to the United States and joined Harvard University. However, after Rajiv Gandhi's assassination in 1991, he left Harvard due to security issues. Rahul subsequently enrolled at Rollins College, graduating with a degree in Arts in 1994. During his time in Florida, his identity was reportedly known only to university authorities and security personnel. In 1995, he completed an MPhil degree from Trinity College Cambridge in the United Kingdom. Career before politics After completing his studies, Rahul Gandhi worked for three years in London with the management consulting firm Monitor Group. Due to security concerns, his identity was kept confidential and he reportedly worked under the name "Raul Vinci". He returned to India in 2002 and became a director of Mumbai-based technology outsourcing company Backops Services Private Limited. Rahul Gandhi formally entered politics in March 2004, beginning a political career that would eventually see him become Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha.

stories.title: ₹2 crore Hapur robbery accused killed in encounter:Looted cash and jewellery from businessman's family; carried a reward of ₹50,000
stories.summary: A key accused in the high-profile Hapur robbery case, in which a businessman's family was held hostage and valuables worth nearly ₹2 crore were looted, was killed in a police encounter late on Thursday night. The accused, identified as Shyam (28), carried a reward of ₹50,000 on his head. During the exchange of fire, Head Constable Manoj Kumar also sustained a gunshot injury. According to Superintendent of Police (SP) KG Singh, the encounter took place at around 10:30 pm during a vehicle-checking operation on Bulandshahr Road under the Hapur Nagar police station area. Accused opened fire after being cornered SP KG Singh said a suspicious motorcyclist attempted to flee after spotting the police. Officers pursued him and alerted Hapur Dehat police. A joint police team eventually surrounded the suspect near Godi village. Realising he was trapped, the accused allegedly took cover behind a tubewell and opened fire on the police team. Officers retaliated, and Shyam was critically injured in the exchange. He was rushed to a government hospital, where doctors declared him dead. Mastermind and gang members arrested earlier Earlier, on 7 June, police arrested five members of the gang following a major encounter on Sultanpur Road. Among those arrested was suspended Uttar Pradesh Police constable Vicky Gautam, who police identified as the mastermind behind the robbery. Multiple criminal cases registered against Shyam The deceased accused, Shyam, son of Virendra, was a resident of Surajpur village under Patwai police station in Rampur district. Police said he was wanted in the Hapur robbery case registered on 1 June and had several criminal cases against him, including charges under the Gangster Act, robbery and dacoity. At least four such cases were registered in districts including Moradabad. First, see the pictures- How was the robbery carried out? The robbery took place on 2 June at the residence of businessman Narendra Agarwal. His 17-year-old grandson, Siddhant, had returned home early from a business trip. According to investigators, the robbers had already been waiting nearby. As soon as Siddhant entered the house, four to five armed men followed him inside. The criminals allegedly pointed a pistol at his head before taking businessman Narendra Agarwal, his wife Sushila Agarwal and the household watchman hostage. The gang demanded ₹2 crore in cash. When the businessman said such an amount was not available in the house, the robbers tied up all family members and the watchman using bedsheets. They confined them to a room and spent nearly an hour searching the property. The gang eventually escaped with approximately 1.25 kg of gold jewellery, silver ornaments and cash worth several lakh rupees from cupboards and lockers. After the robbers fled, the family alerted police. Senior officers, including the DIG and SP, arrived at the scene and launched an investigation. CCTV footage from the surrounding area was examined. CCTV footage led to identification The robbery sparked outrage among traders across Hapur. Business associations questioned the law-and-order situation and gave police a 72-hour ultimatum to crack the case, warning of market closures and protests if no progress was made. During the investigation, police recovered CCTV footage from a location around 150 metres from Narendra Agarwal's residence. The footage showed three suspects fleeing on a motorcycle carrying a bag shortly after the robbery. The images helped investigators identify the accused. How police arrested the gang ? Circle Officer (CO) Varun Mishra said that on the night of 7 June, police teams were conducting checks on Sultanpur Road in the Kotwali Dehat area when they spotted five suspicious men riding two motorcycles. When officers attempted to stop them, the suspects accelerated and allegedly opened fire. Police returned fire, injuring Rohit and Shahbe Alam. The area was cordoned off and five accused were arrested. Those arrested were- Cash, Jewellery and Weapons Recovered Police recovered- Gang conducted reconnaissance for four months Investigators found that the gang had conducted detailed surveillance of the businessman's residence before carrying out the robbery. Initially, police believed the reconnaissance had lasted two months. Further investigation revealed the criminals had monitored the house and its occupants for nearly four months. They gathered information on visitors, security arrangements, family routines, the number of people present in the house and even the location of the safe. Police also arrested Guddu of Moradabad and Tinkoo of Sambhal in connection with the case. According to investigators, Tinkoo's father, Satpal, worked as a mason for the businessman for several months. Police claim Tinkoo supplied crucial information regarding the location of the safe and where its key was kept. Investigators believe this is why the robbers were able to go directly to the places where cash and valuables were stored. Suspended constable had criminal history Vicky Gautam, the alleged mastermind, is originally from Amroha and joined the Uttar Pradesh Police in 2016. He was posted in Sitapur until 2024 but was suspended after remaining absent from duty for ten days without authorisation. Police records show he had previously been jailed in criminal cases. On 19 May 2025, he was arrested in Moradabad's Dilari police station area with old currency notes worth approximately ₹1.5 crore. Investigators also discovered that Vicky Gautam and Tinkoo became acquainted while serving time in jail, a connection that later played a key role in planning and executing the Hapur robbery.

stories.title: Is Akhilesh's Samajwadi Party heading for a split?:21 MPs reject Rajbhar's claim saying 'only those with something to hide would leave'
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Cabinet Minister Om Prakash Rajbhar has claimed that the Samajwadi Party (SP) is heading towards a major split. To verify the claim, Dainik Bhaskar contacted all 37 SP MPs elected to the Lok Sabha. Of the 37 MPs, 16 did not respond to calls, while 21 spoke to the newspaper. They were asked two questions- Most MPs rejected Rajbhar's allegation outright, describing him as a political showman who makes controversial statements for publicity. Several said there was no dissatisfaction within the party and that no MP was considering leaving SP. Rajbhar's claim: Dalit, OBC and General category MPs ready to leave Rajbhar alleged that SP leader Ram Gopal Yadav had submitted a list of names to Union Home Minister Amit Shah and suggested that several SP MPs were ready to switch sides. According to Rajbhar, most Dalit, OBC and General category MPs from Purvanchal, excluding Muslim and Yadav MPs, were prepared to leave the Samajwadi Party. SP won 37 Lok Sabha seats in the 2024 General Election, including 17 seats in Purvanchal- Among them, Ghazipur is represented by Afzal Ansari, while Azamgarh is represented by Dharmendra Yadav. Purvanchal MPs reject Rajbhar's allegations Pushpendra Saroj (Kaushambi)- Rajbhar should first look after his own party. Let him tell us how many MLAs remain with him. BJP has been trying to lure us for years. Only those who are afraid change sides. We are not leaving SP." Rajeev Rai (Ghosi)- Rajbhar has developed a habit of boasting. It has become incurable. He is making such statements out of desperation over securing tickets for his sons. The question of SP MPs joining BJP does not arise. Daroga Prasad Saroj (Lalganj)- Only a thief would leave SP. He must be involved in some sort of brokerage. The national president respected everyone and gave them opportunities. Everything else is false. Ram Prasad Chaudhary (Basti)- That is his style. There is no truth in what he says. He is known for making such statements. No SP MP is going anywhere. Sanatan Pandey (Ballia)- SP gave me the opportunity to become an MLA and then an MP. Rajbhar has now made me internationally famous with his comments. SP is not breaking apart. Babu Singh Kushwaha (Jaunpur)- Where is the list he keeps referring to? He should reveal the names of those who are supposedly leaving and explain what they have done wrong. Priya Saroj (Machhlishahr)- I do not wish to comment on someone whose words and actions rarely match. SP defeated him badly in 2024 and will defeat him again in 2027. Every SP MP stands firmly with the leadership. Virendra Singh (Chandauli)- He is trying to prove his usefulness to BJP. When he was with SP, he criticised Yogi Adityanath. Now that he is with BJP, he criticises SP. No one is leaving. Political observers believe Rajbhar's remarks may be aimed at creating a perception of instability within SP. 'Big Split' narrative Rajbhar has repeatedly compared SP's situation to splits witnessed in parties such as Shiv Sena and Trinamool Congress, claiming that a similar development is inevitable in Uttar Pradesh. Such statements may serve as a signal to any disgruntled leaders contemplating a change of allegiance. Interestingly, SP chief Akhilesh Yadav also acknowledged that those driven by fear or personal interest could leave the party, although he maintained confidence in the party's unity. Linking SP leaders to corruption cases Rajbhar has also linked his allegations to investigations into the mining scam and the Gomti Riverfront project. He claims Ram Gopal Yadav is attempting to shield leaders such as Akhilesh Yadav, Shivpal Yadav and Gayatri Prajapati from the consequences of ongoing investigations. Through this narrative, Rajbhar appears to be portraying SP leaders as individuals attempting to protect themselves from legal scrutiny. Other SP MPs also dismiss the claim Akhilesh Yadav (Kannauj)- BJP has broken many parties and persuaded many SP MLAs and MLCs to switch sides in the past. Whoever is driven by fear or self-interest may leave. We need brave people to take on BJP. SP is ready. Iqra Hasan (Kairana)- Rajbhar should examine whether his own MLAs remain with him. I am in SP and will remain in SP. Harendra Malik (Muzaffarnagar)- Rajbhar is trying to return to SP but is not being accepted. He is making such claims only to improve his standing within BJP. Ruchiveera (Moradabad)- He is not a serious politician. He keeps making random statements. In fact, he himself wants to join SP. Devesh Shakya (Etah)- There is no need to attach importance to someone who changes positions constantly. BJP and Rajbhar should focus on managing their own legislators. Mohibullah (Rampur)- SP MPs are united and stand firmly with Akhilesh Yadav. Rajbhar's allegations are completely detached from reality. Aditya Yadav (Badaun)- BJP thrives on conspiracy theories. No SP MP is leaving. Such statements are made simply to attract attention and increase political relevance. Neeraj Maurya (Aonla)- The defeat suffered by Rajbhar's son in 2024 still appears to be troubling him. SP remains united and will perform even better in 2027. Utkarsh Verma 'Madhur' (Kheri)- He speaks without any basis. Rajbhar is nervous because SP is moving towards forming the next government. Anand Bhadauria (Dhaurahra)- There is not an ounce of truth in these allegations. SP leaders cannot compromise with their ideology. Dharmendra Yadav (Azamgarh- My response is the same as that given by Ram Gopal Yadav. Rambhual Nishad (Sultanpur)- SP gave us opportunities and respect. Why would we leave for BJP? Let Rajbhar first demonstrate his own electoral strength. What the Anti-Defection Law says? At least 25 SP MPs would need to defect together Under India's Anti-Defection Law, MPs or MLAs can merge with another party only if at least two-thirds of the legislature party moves together. For SP, which currently has 37 Lok Sabha MPs, at least 25 MPs would have to switch sides collectively. If only 24 or fewer MPs defected, they would lose their Lok Sabha membership and would be required to seek re-election. This makes any large-scale defection significantly more difficult than political rhetoric may suggest. Why BJP wants a larger majority in Parliament The debate over numbers gained significance after the Modi government introduced three Bills in the Lok Sabha between 16 and 18 April 2026. One of these was a Constitutional Amendment Bill aimed at facilitating the implementation of women's reservation before the 2029 elections. The proposal included provisions to increase the maximum strength of the Lok Sabha from 550 to 850 seats through amendments to Articles 81 and 82 of the Constitution. Constitutional Amendment fell short A Constitutional Amendment requires a special majority- During voting in April 2026, 528 MPs were present in the Lok Sabha. To secure passage, the Bill required 352 votes. However- As a result, the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill fell short by 54 votes. Political analysts believe this arithmetic explains why BJP is keen to increase its parliamentary strength and secure broader support in the Lok Sabha. However, based on the responses of SP MPs, Rajbhar's prediction of an imminent split currently finds little support within the Samajwadi Party itself.

stories.title: Monsoon stalls near UP border for 5 days:Heatwave alert in 25 districts; Banda remains hottest city in country
stories.summary: The delayed arrival of the monsoon in Uttar Pradesh has led to a fresh surge in temperatures across the state. After reaching the state's border, the monsoon has slowed significantly and has remained stalled near the Uttar Pradesh–Chhattisgarh border for the past five days. According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD), it could take up to another week for the monsoon to advance and enter Uttar Pradesh. On Friday morning, strong sunshine was reported across most districts. Low wind speeds have increased humidity levels, making conditions more uncomfortable. A rain alert has been issued for 16 districts, while 25 districts remain under a heatwave warning. During the past 24 hours, intense heat has affected large parts of Purvanchal and Bundelkhand. Banda recorded a maximum temperature of 46°C, making it the hottest city in the country. Monsoon progress remains slow The Meteorological Department said weather activity across Uttar Pradesh is currently limited and scattered. While isolated thunderstorms and light drizzle may occur in some areas, these are unlikely to provide any significant relief from the prevailing heat. Forecasters expect temperatures to continue rising over the next five days, with heatwave conditions likely to remain severe during this period. 'No effective weather system Active in UP' Senior meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said that no effective weather system is currently active over Uttar Pradesh. Atul Kumar Singh said- "At present, no effective weather system is active over Uttar Pradesh. As a result, the monsoon's progress remains slow and conditions are not yet favourable for its entry into the state." According to the Meteorological Department, residents may have to wait approximately another week before the monsoon arrives in Uttar Pradesh. Rain alert in 16 districts, heatwave warning in 25 Although a rain alert has been issued for 16 districts, widespread rainfall is not expected immediately. Meanwhile, 25 districts remain under a heatwave alert as temperatures continue to remain well above normal levels. The combination of intense sunshine, low wind speeds and high humidity has increased discomfort across much of the state. 5-day weather forecast for UP 20 June- Most districts across the state are expected to remain cloudy. Heavy rainfall may occur at isolated locations. 21 June- The weather is likely to remain largely clear across Uttar Pradesh. Strong winds are expected, while cloud movement could trigger light drizzle in some areas. 22 June- Cloud cover is expected across most districts. Parts of eastern Uttar Pradesh may experience heavy rainfall accompanied by strong winds. 23 June- Rainfall is likely in both eastern and western Uttar Pradesh. Strong winds may also occur in several areas. 24 June- Most districts are expected to remain under cloudy skies. Heavy rainfall may occur at isolated locations. Heat likely to persist until monsoon advances With the monsoon stalled near the Uttar Pradesh–Chhattisgarh border and no significant weather system currently supporting its advancement, heatwave conditions are expected to continue across much of the state. Meteorologists believe that meaningful relief from the heat is unlikely until the monsoon makes further progress and becomes active over Uttar Pradesh.
